name: noppo-claudecode-plugins
description: Claude Code plugins and mods by noppomario, aimed at the VS Code extension surface.

plugins.name: mermaid
plugins.description: Draws the mermaid code fences in Claude's replies as box-drawing text, in place, on the terminal.

plugins.name: ui-surface-probe
plugins.description: Diagnostic mod: reports which ui.render surfaces fire and whether the VS Code panel draws rewritten text and Svg elements.

plugins.name: display-probe
plugins.description: Diagnostic plugin: replaces a tokened reply with a battery of rendering candidates, to see which markup a host draws.
